name: Supply Chain Risk Monitor
description: Runs on a configurable schedule to simultaneously fetch supplier status data from the procurement system API and global supply chain news from a risk intelligence feed. An LLM analyzes the combined data to identify disruption risks, severity levels, and recommended mitigation actions. Results are parsed and filtered to surface only high and critical risks, which trigger immediate alerts to the procurement team. Built for manufacturing and logistics operations that need proactive visibility into supply chain vulnerabilities.

data.label: Run every 4 hours during business days
Fetch supplier data and news simultaneously
Fetch active supplier status from procurement API
Combine supplier data and news feeds
Analyze combined data for supply chain risks

config.prompt:
You are a supply chain risk analyst.

Analyze the following supplier data and global news for potential supply chain disruptions.

Supplier Data:
{{supplierData}}

Global News Alerts:
{{newsAlerts}}

For each identified risk, provide:
1. Risk title (concise)
2. Severity: critical, high, medium, low
3. Affected suppliers (by name and ID)
4. Risk category: geopolitical, natural-disaster, logistics, quality, financial, regulatory
5. Potential impact description
6. Recommended mitigation action
7. Urgency: immediate, within-24h, within-week

Output as JSON array of risk objects. Include only risks with severity medium or above.

schema.risks: array of {title, severity, affectedSuppliers, category, impact, mitigation, urgency}

data.label: Filter for high and critical severity risks
Alert procurement team of critical risks
